notes.TOTAL_TRADES_COLLECTED: sum of shards whose trade_count_exact=true only; unknown legacy trade shards are excluded, never zero-filled
notes.TOTAL_UNIQUE_TRADES_GLOBAL: published from deterministic manifest identity digests when coverage is complete, otherwise from TRADE_UNIQUE_COUNT_PATCH.json
notes.TOTAL_UNIQUE_TRADES_WITHIN_SHARDS: deduplicated within each verified shard only; this is not a claim of global cross-shard uniqueness
